OatWheat and Bacteria Assignment Week 2

Megan Youmans

2026-09-01

R Markdown for Oat Dataset

Hypothesis: Higher amount of grain in ears of oats will give a bigger yield, wherein as the amount of grain in ears of oats increases we should see a yield amount that is larger respectively
Types of Variables: Numerical Response is yield, focal predictors is grain. Yield is the response to the predictor of grain amount.

R Markdown for Bacteria Dataset

Hypothesis: Certain bacterial diseases will correlate to certain levels of toxins and therefore we may be able to predict what disease someone may have based on the toxin level based on the differences Types of variables: Categorical, Numerical
